topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Hey, can you believe it? We got Gram’s house! I mean, wow. Just walking through those doors, every corner holds a story, you know? Remember when we used to play hide and seek, and you’d always end up under the old oak desk in the study? And the kitchen, oh, the cookies! I can almost smell them now. It’s like, we’re not just keeping a house, we’re keeping all those moments, too. And now, we get to make new ones. I’m already thinking of the holidays, the parties, the lazy summer afternoons we can spend there. It’s perfect, isn’t it? Let’s plan something soon, just us. We’ve got so much to do!
